text: dsh-record 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的录音插件，会在对话输入框右侧加入麦克风按钮。点击开始录音，再次点击可停止并将音频作为当前会话草稿附件加入提示；录音支持浏览器提供的音频格式，并显示时长。用户可以用 Esc、取消按钮或切换页面放弃录音。适合希望直接在 DSH 网页对话中录制并发送音频的用户。需要浏览器麦克风权限；代码未配置 API 密钥或独立外部服务。

dsh-record adds a microphone button beside the DSH web composer. Record audio and stop to attach it to the current prompt; Escape, cancel, or leaving the page discards it. It uses browser-supported recording formats and requires microphone permission.
想在 DSH 网页对话里直接录一段语音并随消息发出去。
输入框旁边能不能加个麦克风按钮，让我录音后附到当前会话？
I want to record a voice clip in the web chat and attach it to my prompt.
dsh-record 的功能「对话框录音」：点击输入框旁的麦克风开始录音，再次点击后将音频作为当前会话草稿附件加入输入。
dsh-record 的功能「取消未发送录音」：录音过程中按 Esc、点击取消按钮或切换到后台页面，会停止并丢弃本次录音；短于 0.5 秒的录音也不会附加到提示。
dsh-record 将录音交给宿主的会话附件流程；后续传输由 DSH 宿主处理。代码未声明独立 API 密钥或外部服务。（见 src/client/index.tsx:397-417）

dsh-record README · dsh-record：[](LICENSE)

A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin that puts a microphone button in the composer: click to record, click again to stop, and the recording is attached to your current prompt as a conversation file attachment.

[中文文档](README.zh.md)

dsh-record README · Features：- **Composer microphone button** — registered at the `conversation.input.right` slot, before the submit action. No floating widgets; coexists with `dsh-talk` / `dsh-stt` (which use the left slot).
- **Real-time recording** — browser `MediaRecorder`, webm/opus preferred with capability-based fallback. Elapsed timer and live file-name preview while recording (`rec-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS-<n>s.webm`).
- **Prompt attachment** — on stop, the recording is registered through the host draft-attachment channel (`conversation.createDrafts` + `inputActions.addAttachments`) and appears as a composer file card with upload progress. It then rides the normal upload queue with your prompt.
- **Cancel discipline** — Escape, the ✕ button, or leaving the tab discards the recording; recordings under 0.5 s are dropped; a stop during an in-flight submit releases the draft cleanly.

dsh-record README · Features：The plugin records and attaches. It does not transcribe, transcode, or write files to disk — send the attachment to your model, or pair it with a speech-to-text plugin such as `dsh-stt`.

dsh-record README · Install：```bash
git clone https://github.com/most-silence/dsh-record
cd dsh-record && npm install && npm run build
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add file:$PWD
```

Restart the dsh host after installing, then refresh the web page.

dsh-record README · Architecture：```
browser half (lib/client.js)               host half (lib/index.js)
├─ mic button @ conversation.input.right   └─ no-op shell: a valid `main`
├─ MediaRecorder → webm/opus                  entry that registers nothing
└─ attach via createDrafts + addAttachments

dsh-record README · Architecture：The host half is deliberately dependency-free and declares no `Config` schema: an earlier mp3/disk-save iteration added a schemastery schema whose API mismatch aborted the whole profile at startup. Keeping the node half empty means the plugin can never block boot.

dsh-record README · Development：```bash
npm install
npm run build     # tsdown: lib/index.js (ESM) + lib/client.js (CJS, ModuleLoader-wrapped)
npm test          # 7 node:test cases: client factory contract + attachment flow
```

Tests run with Node 24 (native TypeScript type stripping); no browser needed.

dsh-record README · Known limitations：- The attachment channel relies on host client contracts verified on dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 (`conversation.input.right` slot, `createDrafts` / `addAttachments`). Upstream changes may degrade to an inline error notice.
- Recording requires a microphone-permission grant; the page must be served over HTTPS or localhost.
- Audio is attached in the browser's native container (usually WebM/Opus). Transcoding to MP3 or WAV is not part of this version.
